profile.headline: Software Engineer at LinkedIn
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience building scalable UI and consumer-facing applications for millions of users. Strong track record driving authentication, accessibility, and modern UI standards across large-scale organizations. Skilled in modern frontend technologies, with experience mentoring peers, leading accessibility compliance, and creating reusable component libraries.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Owned and scaled LinkedIn’s guest library, adopted by 10+ teams and continuously expanding.
•	Integrated Google, Apple, and Microsoft authentication providers, delivering up to 10% week-over-week conversion lifts across several projects and adding millions of new sign-ups.
•	Refactored legacy components into GraphQL-driven, data-aware designs, eliminating redundant logic and reducing developer build time.
•	Collaborated on team-wide adoption of Storybook; used it to preview, validate, and document new components for broader use.
•	Built new components styled with Tailwind CSS, applying modern design standards to reduce CSS overhead and improve consistency.
•	Led accessibility compliance for sub-org products, mentoring peers on tooling, escalation, and audit practices, ensuring success during LinkedIn’s product assessments.
•	Partnered with design and product teams to deliver scalable UI patterns across LinkedIn’s guest ecosystem.
•	Maintained quality and speed with Jest testing and LinkedIn’s internal CI/CD pipeline.

positions.title: UI Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Architected a multi-product Angular 2+ framework, consolidating shared resources for faster, more consistent feature delivery.
•	Prototyped next-gen UI with React + Redux, influencing modernization efforts.
•	Developed a reusable UI component library that reduced duplicate code and accelerated onboarding.
•	Championed 508 accessibility compliance, modernizing legacy apps and ensuring audit success.
•	Established engineering standards via TypeScript, stylelint, and Jenkins CI, improving code quality.
•	Mentored engineers through training sessions and technical syncs on sustainable front-end practices.
•	Converted a legacy Java UI to AngularJS, improving maintainability.
•	Delivered custom dashboards and analytics visualizations, enabling user-configurable data insights.

positions.title: Front End Web Development Intern
positions.description:
•	Built a consumer-facing health insurance portal serving millions of users, using AngularJS, HTML5, CSS3, and Bootstrap.
•	Developed a responsive Medicaid/Medicare enrollment app, simplifying onboarding for underserved populations.
•	Integrated multi-tenant SaaS platforms across pre-65 and post-65 health markets, enabling scalable deployment. 
•	Enhanced UX with real-time eligibility forms, dashboards, and Google Maps API integration.
•	Improved efficiency and performance by developing reusable AngularJS components.

positions.title: Technical Support Representative
positions.description:
•	Fixed account, connection and computer issues for 100s of consumers on a weekly basis
•	Facilitated modem, router and application integration through remote access configurations

positions.title: Missionary/ESL Teacher
positions.description:
•	Helped improve students’English comprehension and conversational skills
•	Developed classroom strategies and curriculum for ESL learning

projects.title: Code Toads
projects.description:
Competitive application that uses code-based prompts for a fun learning experience.

-Constructed modular ReactJS components for game selection form to facilitate game creation
-Configured Socket.io connection to validate player users/lobbies and game interactions
-Designed and integrated application styles using HTML5/CSS3 to enhance UI

projects.title: Dog Surfing
projects.description:
Home sharing application centered around hosting or asking for others to host one's dog.

-Developed client-side application for creating profiles and posts using AngularJS
-Utilized MongoDB and bcrypt to protect user accounts from unauthorized access and edits
-Integrated location validation with Google Maps APIs for user profile pages
